children: On-chain investigator Specter said someone is impersonating them on Telegram. According to Odaily, Specter said its only official social accounts are Telegram and X, and warned that any other account claiming to represent Specter or to be affiliated with ZachXBT is fake. Specter urged users to stay alert and avoid scams.

title: On-Chain Investigator Specter Warns of Telegram Impersonators, Says Only Two Official Social Accounts
